description: Lists the PM2 processes on the Uptime Kuma host with their name, ID and status. A pm2 monitor names one, by name or ID, in typeFields.system_service_name. Fails if PM2 is not installed where Uptime Kuma runs (it isn't in Uptime Kuma's Docker image).
name: listPM2Processes
title: List PM2 Processes
